description: A DSP48E1 with no *REG attribute keeps its pipeline registers on: no ZMREG, ZPREG or ZOPMODEREG
exercises: the defaults of the DSP48E1 register attributes in the FASM writer
a DSP48E1 instantiated by hand, not inferred by yosys
why: UG479 gives every *REG attribute of the DSP48E1 the default 1, and Vivado builds a DSP without parameters with all its registers on. Release 2026-10-15 reads ALUMODEREG, CARRYINREG, CARRYINSELREG, INMODEREG, MREG, OPMODEREG and PREG with a default of 0, so a DSP48E1 that does not name them is built with those registers off, which is another latency, and the bitstream assembles all the same. A DSP inferred by yosys is not affected: yosys writes every *REG out. The fix reads the seven attributes with the default 1.
